items.t: VICI Properties Faces Higher Credit Provisions: Can Risks Ease?
items.sum: VICI's $458 million credit loss provision hit third-quarter earnings, but rising AFFO highlights underlying growth.

items.t: 3 REIT Giants Paying Big Dividends, Led by VICI’s 7.6% Yield
items.sum: One of these REIT giants slashed its dividend, another leans on two casino tenants for 70% of its rent, and the third pays the biggest check per share. Cash flow math reveals which payouts deserve your trust.

items.t: VICI Properties: The Discount Is An Opportunity
items.sum: Analyst rates VICI Properties a Buy, down from Strong Buy: 1.03x Caesars lease coverage raises risk, while valuation appears to discount a large rent cut.

items.t: Can Shares Rally Higher on VICI's $2B Buyback Plan & Raised Outlook?
items.sum: VICI's $2B buyback authorization, raised 2026 AFFO outlook and 7.4% dividend yield bolster its appeal, but tenant risks and funding questions cloud its rally.

items.t: Dividend Investing When Things Go South
items.sum: Rising yields have pressured some dividend portfolios. Yields are not the only thing that could throw a wrench in the works for dividend investors.

items.t: How to Build $9,450 a Month in Dividend Income Without Selling a Single Share
items.sum: A 12% yield sounds like the fastest route to a paycheck without selling shares. But one slower-paying approach can outgrow it, and inflation quietly punishes the flashy choice. Which six holdings make the math work?
